prev_agent: Here's the summary of the issue and fix: **Root cause:** Two ClickHouse SQL bugs in `project.service.ts`: 1. **`GROUP BY alias` with column-referencing expressions** — The queries used `GROUP BY project_key` where `project_key` is an alias for `if(git_remote != '', git_remote, ...)`. ClickHouse v26 can't resolve the raw column references when expanding the alias in GROUP BY scope. **Fix:** Use the full expression in `GROUP BY` instead of the alias. 2. **Aggregate alias collision** — `any(project_path) AS project_path` creates an alias with the same name as the table column. When ClickHouse resolves the GROUP BY expression (which references `project_path`), it finds the aggregate alias instead of the table column, causing `ILLEGAL_AGGREGATION` error. **Fix:** Rename the aggregate alias to `_project_path` and update the service mapping code. **Changes:** - `project.service.ts`: Fixed both `getProjectInvestment` and `getProjectTrends` queries - `analytics.integration.ts`: Replaced `test.todo` with actual test implementations for `investment`, `trends`, and `details`
